sentences.en: So, tell me a little about yourself.
sentences.zh: 那么，请简单介绍一下你自己。
sentences.tip:
重音：tell · little · yourself
连读：tell me → tel-me；about yourself → abou-chur-self
提示：tell me 的 m 和 a 连读；yourself 重音在 self。

sentences.en: I've been working as a product designer for about three years.
sentences.zh: 我做产品设计师大约三年了。
sentences.tip:
重音：working · product · designer · three · years
连读：as a → a-za；for about → fo-ra-bout
提示：I've been 弱读成 aiv-bin，重点信息放在 three years。

sentences.en: What made you want to apply for this role?
sentences.zh: 是什么让你想申请这个职位？
sentences.tip:
重音：What · want · apply · role
连读：want to → wanna；apply for → apply-fer
提示：want to 口语里常说 wanna；apply 重音在第二音节。

sentences.en: I'm really drawn to your focus on accessibility.
sentences.zh: 我真的很被你们对无障碍设计的专注吸引。
sentences.tip:
重音：really · drawn · focus · accessibility
连读：drawn to → drawn-tuh；focus on → focu-son
提示：drawn to 连读；accessibility 重音在 bil。

sentences.en: That's great to hear. When could you start?
sentences.zh: 很高兴听你这么说。你什么时候能入职？
sentences.tip:
重音：great · hear · When · start
连读：could you → coul-joo
提示：could you 连读成 coul-joo，句尾 start 降调。
